THE ESPRESSO

Prepare your espresso

Drag the portafilter beneath the grinder.

Place tools freely on the counter. Nearby targets help you line up the equipment. Drop the tamper to press coffee. Insert the basket to lock. Tap the brew lever to start or stop. Each finished shot returns the basket so you can grind another dose. Bring the milk jug or espresso cup near the glass rim and release to pour automatically. Pick it up again to pause. Carry the ice scoop from its bucket to add four cubes; the bucket has ten cubes in total. Ice can be added after liquid; excess liquid is displaced. Put the spoon in the glass, then drag left and right to stir. Pull down to lift the spoon out. Scoop as much sugar as the glass can hold. The coaster holds your finished drink. Only New drink or reset clears it. Tab selects equivalent keyboard controls; Enter performs placements, Space operates levers, Enter pours automatically, Down pours while held, and Left or Right stirs. Escape cancels.

This coffee needs WebGL.

Enable hardware acceleration in your browser, then reload to enter the 3D scene.
